description: This file contains implementation of metrics printing utilities for Kubernetes, including classes and methods for printing node and pod metrics, handling resource usage, and managing missing resources.

classes.name: ResourceMetricsInfo
classes.description: Holds resource metrics data for a node or pod, including name, metrics, and available resources.

classes.name: TopCmdPrinter
classes.description: Handles printing of node and pod metrics, including formatting and resource usage calculations.

methods.name: NewTopCmdPrinter
methods.description: Constructor for TopCmdPrinter, initializes with output writer and swap resource display option.

methods.name: PrintNodeMetrics
methods.description: Prints metrics for nodes, including resource usage and missing metrics.

methods.name: PrintPodMetrics
methods.description: Prints metrics for pods, optionally including container details and resource sums.

methods.name: RegisterMissingResource
methods.description: Records missing resources for a node.

methods.name: printSinglePodMetrics
methods.description: Prints metrics for a single pod.

methods.name: printSinglePodContainerMetrics
methods.description: Prints metrics for each container within a pod.

methods.name: printMetricsLine
methods.description: Prints a line of resource metrics.

methods.name: printAllResourceUsages
methods.description: Prints resource usage and percentage for each resource.

methods.name: printSingleMissingResource
methods.description: Prints placeholder for missing resource data.

methods.name: printPodResourcesSum
methods.description: Prints sum of resources across pods.
